title: Achievement progress recorded
description: A player progressed a progress achievement without unlocking it. Emitted alongside qtiauth.games.achievement.unlocked.v1 when the progress hits the target.

game_id.description: The game the achievement belongs to.

achievement_slug.description: Stable per-game identifier for the achievement.

trust.description: The trust level the write was accepted at.

progress.description: The player's current progress after this update.

progress_target.description: The target at which the achievement unlocks.
